meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 分析 Karpathy 模式的 LLM wiki 知识库（含原始资料、wiki 标记和 schema 文件），检测其中的文章、来源、主题和链接，提取实体与隐式关系，生成交互式知识图谱仪表盘，并保存图谱和元数据。
howto.when: 当用户给出 wiki 目录路径（或当前目录）并请求分析知识库时触发；检测到存在 index.md 和多个带 wikilinks 的 .md 文件等 Karpathy 模式特征后开始处理。

say.text: 分析这个 wiki 知识库，生成交互式知识图谱
say.note: 将检测格式并执行完整分析流程。

say.text: 请理解我的 Karpathy 模式知识库并创建图谱
say.note: 需要目录参数或当前目录。

say.text: 运行 understand-knowledge，分析 ./wiki 并展示结果

howto.what_en: Analyzes a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema), extracts entities and implicit relationships, and generates an interactive knowledge graph dashboard with topic clustering, saving graph and metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user gives a wiki directory (or current dir) and requests analysis; proceeds after detecting Karpathy-pattern signs such as index.md and .md files with wikilinks.

say_en.text: Analyze this wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph
Understand my Karpathy-pattern knowledge base and create a graph
say_en.note: Needs a directory argument or current dir.

say_en.text: Run understand-knowledge on ./wiki and show the result
